Sub: Intimation of Schedule of Conference Call to discuss the Earning Performance of the 
Company for the Quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/ Ma’am, 
  
In compliance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”), we wish to inform 
that the Company has scheduled a Conference Call (Universal Dial in +91 22 6280 1222 / +91 
22 7115 8123) with the Investors & Analysts to discuss the earning performance of the 
Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on Monday,                    
November 02, 2026, at 17:00 hours (IST), the details of which are enclosed herewith. 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 46 of SEBI Listing Regulations, details of the earning performance 
conference 
call, 
will 
be 
made 
available 
on 
the 
Company’s 
website 
at                           
https://www.escortskubota.com/investors/financials. Further, the audio recording of the 
aforesaid call will be made available on the Company’s website and its weblink will be filed 
with the Stock Exchanges, before the next trading day. The written transcript will be available 
within 5 working days of the conclusion of such call on the above-mentioned weblink. 
 
Further, please note that no unpublished price sensitive information is proposed to be shared 
during the call. 
 
The above is for your kind information and records. 
 
Thanking You, 
Yours faithfully, 
For Escorts Kubota Limited 
 
 
 
Vicky Chauhan 
Company Secretary 
Encl.: As above
